core_cases.prompt: Compare concepts/retry-policy.md and concepts/network-retry.md in the configured temporary Wiki for page-level identity collision. Report confidence and evidence, choose a proposed canonical identity, and describe how unique provenance and inbound links would be preserved. Do not merge.

oracle.expected_outcome: The pages are classified as a high-confidence identity collision, retry-policy.md is proposed as canonical, the unique incident provenance and inbound link are included in the merge plan, and no files change.

assertions.description: The analysis uses title, aliases, summary, claims, and provenance to distinguish duplicate identity from mere topical overlap and justifies its confidence.
The proposal names retry-policy.md as canonical and explicitly preserves incident-42 plus the inbound link from projects/importer.md.
The focused audit does not write, redirect, or rewrite links.

fixtures.content:
---
title: Network Retry Policy
aliases: [Retry Policy]
summary: Retry transient network failures three times with backoff.
status: active
confidence: high
sources: [incident-42]
---

Transient network failures retry at most three times. Validation failures do not retry.

# Importer

The importer follows [[concepts/network-retry|its retry policy]].

core_cases.prompt: Compare concepts/retry-policy.md with concepts/idempotency.md. They both discuss request reliability, but decide whether they represent the same page identity. Do not merge or edit either page.

oracle.expected_outcome: The workflow classifies the pages as related but distinct concepts, explains that retry policy governs attempts while idempotency governs duplicate-effect safety, and proposes no merge.

assertions.description: The report rejects a duplicate classification based on the pages' different definitions and responsibilities rather than topic similarity.
No canonical page, redirect, content merge, or link rewrite is performed.

fixtures.content:
---
title: Idempotency
summary: Repeating a request does not create duplicate effects.
status: active
confidence: high
---

Idempotency keys prevent duplicate writes when clients repeat a request. This is distinct from deciding whether or how often to retry.

core_cases.prompt: Prepare to merge concepts/retry-policy.md and concepts/network-retry.md. Present the canonical page, preserved content, redirect, and inbound-link updates, then wait: I have not confirmed the merge.

oracle.expected_outcome: A concrete merge plan is shown, including the canonical page, incident provenance, redirect stub, and inbound-link rewrite, but all fixture files remain unchanged pending confirmation.

assertions.description: The plan covers identity decision, canonical page, unique content and provenance, redirect, link rewrites, and post-write validation.
No page merge, redirect creation, inbound-link rewrite, or maintenance write occurs before confirmation.
